pages.title: Claytronic Catom
pages.text: One cell of claytronics: a tiny module that can join with others, move across their surfaces and form any shape. Millions of catoms together can become anything at all. A single one is a smooth bead that rolls toward its neighbours whenever it can.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Nanite Assembler, I packed programmable matter into a Superposition Crystal shell. The result could hold many shapes at once, and it could combine with others into any form I asked for.
Made in $(item)Nanite Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Molecular Nanotechnology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Reality Anchor, Von Neumann Probe.
